title: Unforgettable Wine Experience in Sitges – A Must-Do for Wine Lovers
text:
We had an incredible time with Anatoly and Oleg. This isn’t just a wine tasting—it’s a personal journey through exceptional, small-production wines you won’t find in typical shops or restaurants. Their passion for family-run wineries and artisanal winemaking is contagious, and they explain everything with clarity and enthusiasm.

The setting is intimate and relaxed, perfect for both curious beginners and experienced wine enthusiasts. It felt more like spending time with friends who truly love what they do. This was easily one of the highlights of our trip to Sitges.

title: Genuine, relaxed, and seriously good wine
text:
I’ve been to three Sitges Wine Club tastings now and every single one has completely changed the way I think about wine 🍷✨

If you’re curious about natural wines, or just looking for a fun, beautifully curated experience with great people, this is a must. Anatoly & Oleg create something really special: it’s intimate, warm, and totally unpretentious. You’ll discover artisanal, family-run wines you’d never find on your own and walk away with new favorites (and probably new friends).

title: Excellent tour.
text: Excellent vineyard tour and wine tasting organised by Anatoly and Oleg. Booking was easy, we were picked up near our apartment and had a fantastic morning visiting a family run Biodynamic  vineyard. Both Anatoly and Oleg are passionate and very knowledgeable about wine and do a great deal to support smaller, family run organisations, and they are also very nice people. Very highly recommended.

title: Wine tour worth repeating!
text: Anatoly and Oleg are very passionate about all things wine and wine. They have organized for us a nice tour to a small artisanal winery. First they picked us up near where we stayed. The tour itself went through the vineyards, wine cellars and ended with a fine wine tasting. We had a very nice afternoon as those interested in the wine business and we are definitely going to follow another tour or tasting at Copas Llenas!
